modulation of relaxation of muscle in other organism
regulation of relaxation of muscle in other organism
related: modulation of relaxation of muscle in another organism

definition: A process in which an organism induces paralysis in another organism via the action of a venom. Paralysis is the loss of the ability to voluntarily control muscles. This can occur by blocking nerve signals at the neuromuscular junction or by directly interfering with muscle contraction.
label: venom-mediated paralysis
